newsitem.title: USA: Metrologic sees Q2 below analysts views.
newsitem.headline: Metrologic sees Q2 below analysts views.

text.p: Metrologic Instruments Inc said Wednesday it expects sales and earnings per share for the second quarter ended June 30 to be slightly less than analysts estimates.

The company said it expects sales to be between $13.0 million and $13.2 million, compared with analysts' expectations of $13.8 million. It expects earnings per share to be between $0.11 per share and $0.13 compared with analysts' estimates of $0.16 per share.
The company said these shortfalls in expectations are due to delays in orders for its new HoloTrak series of holographic industrial laser bar code scanners.

Metrologic said the HoloTrak series of industrial laser scanners, introduced in 1996, have a much longer sales cycle than the company experienced with its point-of-sale products. The company said the HoloTrak products are subject to evaluations and tests by many potential users, which often result in nine-month to one-year sales cycles.
For the same period a year ago, the company's sales were about $11.8 million and net income per share was $0.13 per share.
Metrologic will announce its results on July 24.
Metrologic makes and sells bar code scanning equipment.
